title: Beyond Appearance Shifts: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models
titleZh: Beyond Appearance Shifts：面向 VLA 模型的任务语义动作校准
short_description: BAS-VLA helps vision-language-action policies stay stable when appearance changes and adapt when the task changes. A residual action calibrator learns from matched clean, task-preserving, and semantic-breaking examples, while a selective visual auxiliary supports robustness across simulation and real-robot manipulation.
shortDescriptionZh: BAS-VLA 让视觉-语言-动作策略在外观变化时保持稳定，在任务语义变化时调整动作。方法通过配对的原始、任务保持与语义改变样本学习残差动作校准，并结合选择性视觉辅助，提升仿真与真实机器人操作中的鲁棒性。
